title: The Market Is Crashing and I Just Bought $8,000 of These 4 Stocks
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garbled in places (some price figures inconsistent)
summary: Couch Investor gives a portfolio update after a brutal week: his portfolio fell 6.18% against the S&P 500's 2.66% drop, but is still up 12.78% year to date versus 7.88% for the index. On Tuesday he bought 10 shares of Nvidia, 3 of Meta, 7 of Alphabet and 125 of SoFi, and cut his PayPal bull spread in half to raise cash. He walks through the technical picture name by name: Alphabet's buy zone is $260-270 against ~$284; Meta is 'extremely undervalued' in the low $600s with support at $500-520; SoFi is in its buy zone around $16.21. He is now thinking of buying Micron, calling it extremely cheap at 3-4x forward earnings and arguing HBM changes the memory cycle — annual cadence and no more inventory stockpiling — with very large free cash flow expected over the next three fiscal years. He reviews Axon's quarter (revenue +28%, software +43%, ARR +40% to $1.8B, record 126% net retention) and wants to lift it from 2.36% to above 3% of the portfolio. He previews a big earnings week — Rocket Lab Monday, CoreWeave Tuesday, Nebius Thursday — and argues the midterm-driven data-centre sell-off is an overreaction, since 2027-28 capacity is mostly already under construction. Calls: NVDA BUY, META BUY, GOOGL BUY (flip from HOLD), SOFI BUY, AXON BUY (all reiterated except GOOGL), MU CONDITIONAL_BUY (flip from HOLD), AVGO CONDITIONAL_BUY (softened from BUY).
